blocks.text: Ionic radius crystal lattice (ions ki tarteeb wala dhancha) mein ion ke size ka measure (naap) hai. Aam taur par ise ion ke nucleus se bahar wale electron shell tak ka fasla kehte hain, aur yeh picometers (pm) ya angstroms (Å) mein napa jata hai. Jab atom ek ya zyada electrons kho kar positive ion banta hai to woh aam taur par neutral atom se chhota ho jata hai. Wajah: electrons kam hone se electrons ki aapas ki repulsion (dhakelna) kam hoti hai aur baqi electrons nucleus ke qareeb khinch jate hain. Is ke ulat jab atom ek ya zyada electrons le kar anion (negative ion) banta hai to woh neutral atom se bara ho jata hai. Wajah: naye electrons se repulsion barhti hai, har electron par nucleus ki kheench kam hoti hai aur electron cloud phail jata hai.

Period mein baen se daen jate hue cations (positive ions) ka ionic radius kam hota hai, kyun ke barhta hua nuclear charge electrons ko qareeb kheenchta hai. Anions ka ionic radius bhi period mein kam hota hai, isi wajah se ke barhta nuclear charge electrons ko nucleus ke qareeb kheenchta hai.

Doosri taraf group mein neeche jate hue cations aur anions dono ka size barhta hai. Wajah: principal quantum number (n) barhta hai, yani electron shells barhte hain. Is liye nucleus aur bahar wale electrons ka fasla barh jata hai, aur yeh asar barhe hue nuclear charge se zyada hota hai. Extra shells ions ko bara kar dete hain.

blocks.alt: Ions apne asal atoms ke oopar bane hain, radius picometre mein (oopar ion, neeche atom). Cations, bhoore atom par surkh: Li+ 60/152, Be2+ 31/111; Na+ 95/186, Mg2+ 65/160, Al3+ 50/143; K+ 133/231, Ca2+ 99/197, Ga3+ 62/122; Rb+ 148/244, Sr2+ 113/215, In3+ 81/162. Anions, bhoore atom ke gird neela-hara: N3- 171/70, O2- 140/66, F- 136/64; S2- 184/104, Cl- 181/99; Se2- 198/117, Br- 185/114; Te2- 221/137, I- 216/133.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har khaane mein do number hain: oopar wala ion ka radius, neeche wala atom ka. Baen grid mein cations hain: surkh ion apne bhoore (brown) atom ke andar hai, yani electron khone se ion chhota ho gaya (Na 186 se Na⁺ 95). Daen grid mein anions hain: neela-hara ion bhoore atom se bara hai, yani electron lene se ion phail gaya (Cl 99 se Cl⁻ 181). Har grid mein neeche jayen to dono radius barhte hain, aur row mein daen jayen to kam hote hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Atomic aur ionic radii par kaun se factors asar dalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Atomic number (nuclear charge), effective nuclear charge, shells ki tadaad (principal quantum number n) aur andar wale electrons ka shielding effect. Ions ke liye electrons ka khona ya lena bhi: cation chhota aur anion bara hota hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Period 2 ke elements (kitab mein “Period 3” chhapa hai) ki maloomat se relative size (ek doosre ke muqable size) batayein: (i) lithium aur fluorine ke atomic radii (ii) lithium atom aur Li⁺ (iii) oxygen atom aur O²⁻ (iv) nitride ion N³⁻ aur fluoride ion F⁻.
blocks.explanation: (i) Lithium bara hai, fluorine chhota: dono ke do shells hain magar fluorine ka nuclear charge (+9) lithium (+3) se kahin zyada hai. (ii) Li⁺ lithium atom se chhota hai: is ne apna 2s electron (poora bahar wala shell) kho diya. (iii) O²⁻ oxygen atom se bara hai: do extra electrons se repulsion barhti hai aur cloud phailta hai. (iv) N³⁻ bara hai: dono mein 10 electrons hain, magar nitrogen ke nucleus mein 7 protons aur fluorine mein 9, is liye N³⁻ ke electrons kam attraction (kashish) se bandhe hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Quick Check 1.5(b) mein “Period 3 elements” likhti hai, lekin lithium, fluorine, oxygen aur nitrogen Period 2 ke elements hain.

items: Ionic radius: lattice mein ion ke nucleus se bahar wale shell tak. Cation apne atom se chhota, anion apne atom se bara.
Dono qism ke ions period mein chhote aur group mein neeche bare hote hain.
